tasks.title: JS: data-driven dialog engine (wo-dialogs.js) + TableStyler/HSBColorPicker/MultiSliderGradient widgets
tasks.description: PORT-PLAN Phase 3 item 1+2. ORM-09 requires ~10k lines of OO views; hand-entered HTML is REJECTED — build a generic engine. Create apps/web/apps/documenteditor-wysiwyg/wo-dialogs.js exporting a WoDialogEngine: build(spec) where spec = {id, title, sections:[{title, rows:[{type:'button'|'checkbox'|'number'|'select'|'text'|'color'|'custom', key, label, min, max, options, cmd}]}], width}. Engine must (a) create the modal overlay + panel DOM with the same aria-modal + focus-trap conventions as existing dialogs and register ids into editor.js DIALOG_IDS, (b) emit commands through data-wo-cmd attributes so the existing recordCommand/replayCommands ledger catches them, (c) apply data-i18n and register strings through the existing seedUiStrings/i18n.js seed mechanism (add en+de strings for engine chrome: Dialog.Ok/Cancel/Apply/Title defaults). Ship the three prerequisite widgets as spec type 'custom' factories in the same file: tableStyler(border-style/width/color painting grid), hsbColorPicker(hue/sat/bright sliders + hex + preview), multiSliderGradient(draggable stops, add/remove, color per stop). Load wo-dialogs.js from index.html via <script type=module>. Test wo-dialogs.test.mjs (pattern: read files, assert, print WO-DIALOGS-PASS): engine builds DOM from a 2-section spec, every cmd row gets data-wo-cmd, i18n keys exist en+de, three widget factories exported, index.html loads the file, DIALOG_IDS gains engine-registered ids. Do NOT regress the 60 existing .test.mjs files.
